listing.summary: Experimental project. native 3D/sound/widescreen at 60 FPS claim; game-specific interrupt fixes; release packaging undone, no full playthrough. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: USA SLUS-00684 JackieChan own disc plus own SCPH1001 BIOS. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build pinned PSXRecomp tools, translate own BIOS/disc, link title framework fixes and build runtime. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.
